eyebrow: CAFE & LIGHT MEALS · LAYOUT TO SOURCING
title: A better coffee bar starts with the workflow.
intro: Source a cafe equipment package from China around your menu, peak service and available space. Bring espresso machines, grinders, ice machines, undercounter refrigeration and pastry displays into one brief, with DDNZ coordinating configuration checks, supplier quotations and export preparation.
gallery: See the bar from six working angles
galleryIntro: Explore the relationship between the front bar, back bar and equipment. Open any image for a closer look.
captions: Front and back counter layout concept
Counter positions, wash area and internal circulation
Coffee service, display and back-bar working areas
Espresso machine, grinders, cup storage and undercounter refrigeration
Countertop equipment and undercounter cabinet arrangement

note: Original dimensions, dimension lines and equipment layouts are retained; Chinese annotations have been translated into English. Unclear or inconsistent values remain as supplied and must be checked against site measurements before ordering or fabrication.
zones: Group the espresso machine, grinders, knockbox, cup rinser and cup storage around the barista. Discuss group count, grinder quantity and access to milk against peak orders.

Check ice production, storage capacity and ice-bin use separately. Select milk refrigeration, frozen-ingredient storage and ice storage for their respective duties, with ventilation and maintenance access.

Confirm whether the menu needs reheating, baking or food preparation before choosing the oven and prep counter. Match pastry display temperature to the food and keep checkout clear of the preparation surface.
Define the roles of sinks, cup rinsers and dishwashers, then map water treatment, supply, drainage and power. Discuss used-ware return, restocking and staff circulation.

procureTitle: Coordinate the equipment and custom counter before ordering
procure: A coffee bar can involve several equipment and cabinet suppliers. DDNZ can help compare models, dimensions, materials, lead times and packing against one schedule, coordinate drawing and cutout checks before production, and follow up production, inspection and consolidated export. The quotation defines the agreed scope.
briefTitle: Start with your menu and measured space
brief: Share the destination, available counter dimensions, menu, peak cups per hour, site power and equipment you already own. Use these to discuss the package and outstanding connections, with equipment, custom cabinetry and freight itemized separately.
review: Review your brief and add contact details on the next page. Nothing is sent here.
boundary: Confirm final models, dimensions, loads, water connections and installation clearances against a measured site and manufacturer documents. Local professionals should review installation and approval requirements.
